LAN IP Setup: Address Reservation

When you specify a reserved IP address for a device on the LAN, that device will always receive the same IP address each time it accesses the DHCP server. Reserved IP addresses should be assigned to servers that require permanent IP settings.

Attached Devices Table

The Attached Devices Table displays the attached devices on your network that are available for IP reservation

To Reserve An IP Address

  • Select the radio button of the device you wish to add from the Address Reservation Table
  • If the device you wish to add isn't on the list click Refresh to update the table
  • If the device is still not on the Address Reservation Table enter the IP Address, MAC Address, and Device Name of the device you wish to add
  • Select Add when finished
